technical-summary: Opt-in lab mode that splits LTX guidance passes by native block range across the R9700 and both XTX cards with a pinned-host hand-off: 4.0% (768x512x121) and 8.8% (1216x704x121) faster than the 2/1/1 placement including transfer, 1.82x and 1.73x over the R9700 alone; same-card outputs bit-identical, cross-card about 1.5-2% relative RMS. Also records that gfx1030 cannot run the text encoder or VAE with the current libr2 rows.
user-summary-candidate: Measured that splitting LTX guidance passes by block range gives 1.7-1.8x over the R9700 alone.
